bounds.connection_deadline_scope: Client and socket/frame I/O only; server mutation completion may exceed it while SQLite waits up to ten seconds

broker_acknowledgment: Receiver-local commit only; asynchronous replication, no quorum/consensus or simultaneous unreplicated source-and-broker loss guarantee
limitations: Trusted shared cluster capability, local TCP and application-level link gates
Receiver-local commit ACK; asynchronous broker replication without quorum
Per-boot counters; socket deadline does not bound mutation completion
Manual receive-crash replay and within-batch reorder tests only
No API, Docker, candidate execution, money or release authority
stats_since_boot reset after restart; live fault comparisons require durable telemetry or external accumulation across every boot
Client timeout leaves mutation outcome ambiguous; reconcile using stable command IDs/content bindings rather than treating timeout as rollback
Manual incoming-merge crash replay and within-batch event reorder are narrower than autonomous receive-crash recovery and network packet reordering
Loopback transport-denial tests do not establish WAN, kernel packet loss or host-loss behavior.
Broker fixtures have two clients and two relay services; equivalent live-worker resources and healthy capacity are not established.
HMAC authenticates trusted cluster capability, not Byzantine producer identity; this is not production authentication.
